keyFormat.description: Defaults to {project}-{number} for YouTrack/Jira/Linear; #{number} for GitHub/GitLab.

urlTemplate.description: Provider-specific task link using {baseUrl}, {key}, or {number} for GitHub/GitLab.

matchBareNumbers.description: GitHub/GitLab only. Match short #123 references (default true). Only one tracker per checkout can claim these; qualified project#123 references always work.

projects.description: Required prefixes for YouTrack/Jira/Linear; empty for GitHub/GitLab.

repository.description: Web URL of this Git checkout. Defaults to origin; never a credential URL.

maxCommits.description: Maximum reachable commits inspected from HEAD. Truncation is reported.
